entries.appliesTo: no bound party — defines "artificial intelligence" for the Mississippi Code (definitional only)

sources.family: SECTION 1 — 'The term "artificial intelligence" means a machine-based system that can, for a given set of human-defined objectives, make predictions, recommendations or decisions influencing real or virtual environments.'
sources.category: SECTION 2 — 'Section 1 of this act shall be codified in Chapter 3, Title 1, Mississippi Code of 1972.'

flags: Bill binds no one: it only defines 'artificial intelligence' and codifies the definition in Chapter 3, Title 1 (general provisions of the Mississippi Code). None of the four categories fits a pure definitions act; 'public-sector' is coded as the least-wrong forced choice since the definition operates only on construction of state statutes.
No duties, parameters, or penalty/enforcement provisions in the enacted text; exposure omitted (silence is silence).
